description:
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling target player's graveyard.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from the top of your library by paying 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
